sentences.text:
Respondent :- Union Of India And 4 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sunil Kumar Singh,Pramod Kumar Pandey

Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,C.S.C.,Neeraj Dube,Sudheer,Suman Jaiswal Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
Heard Sri Om Prakash Chaurasia, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Neeraj Dubey, learned counsel, who appears for N.H.A.I.
The petitioner claims to be owner/ bhumidhar of Gata No. 105 area 0.1060 hectares situate at village Deokali, Pargana and Tehsil Saidpur, District Ghazipur.

He claims that the land in question has been utilized for construction of National Highway and a notification under Section 3-D of the National Highways Act, 1956 had been published, but payment of compensation for only an area of 0.0596 hectares has been made.
The payment of compensation for rest of 0.0464 hectares of the said plot has not been made to the petitioner.

It is, thus, sought to be submitted that though, the respondents had acquired the total area of Gata no.105 area 0.1060 hectares, but the compensation for an area of 0.0464 hectares has not been paid to the petitioner.

sentences.text: In the counter affidavit, the stand of the respondent/ NHAI is that the road has been constructed only in an area of 0.0598 hectares of Gata No.105, compensation of which has been disbursed to the land owners and no additional area of NHAI-29 project has been utilized.

In the supplementary affidavit, it is sought to be reiterated by the learned counsel for the petitioner based on the report that excess area of the plot in question has been utilized by the NHAI as against the area shown in the acquisition notification of the year 2005.
Annexure-'SA1' is the acquisition Notification, complete copy of which has not been filed.

In the counter affidavit of Respondent/
NHAI, the copy of the acquisition notification showing acquired area of the Gata No. 105 has not been brought on record.
In the said situation, it is not possible for us to ascertain the extent of acquisition and the claim of the petitioner that excess area of plot in question has been utilized by NHAI.

However, in order to bring the dispute to its logical end, we permit the petitioner to approach the Collector, Ghazipur by moving an application raising a dispute with regard to utilization of excess area of plot no.105, over and above the area acquired by the acquisition notifications issued under the National Highways Act, 1956.

It is provided that in case, the petitioner moves an application along with a copy of this order within a period of two weeks from today, the notice shall be issued to Respondent / NHAI calling upon it to produce the entire record pertaining to acquisition of the plot in question before the Collector.

The Collector shall peruse the record of the acquisition produced by the NHAI and tally it with the record of acquisition of the office of the competent authority pertaining to determination of compensation.

A revenue team of not less than three revenue officials shall be constituted to make a spot inspection of the site in question, to ascertain the extent of area of Gata no.105 of village Deokali, Pargana and Tehsil Saidpur, District Ghazipur, utilized by the NHAI for construction of NH-29.
During the course of spot inspection, the petitioner and the representatives of the NHAI shall participate.
The report of the revenue team shall be provided to the petitioners and the representatives of NHAI.

The Collector, after perusal of the report of the revenue team and the records of acquisition, as directed above, shall determine the claim of the petitioner, the dispute raised by him about the utilization of excess area of plot in question by the NHAI.

In case, claim of the petitioner finds positive consideration, the determination of compensation for the excess area under utilization by NHAI by taking into account the current circle rate of the area in question, shall be made by the Collector.
During the exercise of determination of compensation, due notice shall also be given to NHAI to contest their claim about computation.
In any case, the entire exercise shall be completed within a period of four months from the date of receipt of the application.
The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed off.

Order Date :- 21.3.2023 N.S.Rathour  Chandrasekhar vs Union Of India And 4 Others on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8398616/
